description: Header file defining classes and structures related to Vertex Attributes and Bindings in OpenGL ES 3.1, including VertexBinding and VertexAttribute classes, with associated methods and data structures.

classes.name: VertexBinding
classes.description: Represents a binding point for vertex attributes, managing stride, divisor, offset, buffer association, and attribute mask.

classes.name: VertexAttribute
classes.description: Represents a vertex attribute, including format, pointer, binding index, and cached element limit.

methods.name: explicit VertexBinding(GLuint boundAttribute)
methods.description: Constructor initializing VertexBinding with a bound attribute.

methods.name: VertexAttribute(GLuint bindingIndex)
methods.description: Constructor for VertexAttribute with specified binding index.

methods.name: updateCachedElementLimit
methods.description: Updates cached element limit based on binding.

methods.name: setFloatValues
methods.description: Sets float values for vertex attribute current value data.

methods.name: setIntValues
methods.description: Sets integer values for vertex attribute current value data.

methods.name: setUnsignedIntValues
methods.description: Sets unsigned integer values for vertex attribute current value data.
